$comment: Basic-OP subset only. The spec is NOT sealed in specs.json, so a citation with no row here is a note rather than a failure while the rest is filled in.

requirements.quote: Authorization Servers MUST support the use of the HTTP GET and POST methods defined in RFC 7231 at the Authorization Endpoint.
prompt — none: The Authorization Server MUST NOT display any authentication or consent user interface pages. An error is returned if an End-User is not already authenticated.
requirements.$comment: #318. Before it, a silent-renewal request rendered a login form inside the client's hidden iframe and hung until timeout.

requirements.quote: The Client MUST validate the ID Token in the Token Response... The Issuer Identifier for the OpenID Provider MUST exactly match the value of the iss (issuer) Claim.

If a nonce value was sent in the Authentication Request, a nonce Claim MUST be present and its value checked to verify that it is the same value as the one that was sent in the Authentication Request.

acr — OPTIONAL. Authentication Context Class Reference. String specifying an Authentication Context Class Reference value that identifies the Authentication Context Class that the authentication performed satisfied.
email_verified — True if the End-User's e-mail address has been verified; otherwise false.
requirements.applies: ID token, userinfo and access-token convenience claims
requirements.$comment: ADR-002: QAuth omits BOTH claims when there is no verified attribute, rather than emitting email_verified:false. Presence is the verification signal.

requirements.quote: at_hash — Access Token hash value... This is REQUIRED when the ID Token is issued from the Authorization Endpoint with an access_token value.
requirements.reason: QAuth supports only the authorization code flow (response_types_supported is ['code']). An ID token is never issued from the authorization endpoint, so at_hash and c_hash never apply.

requirements.quote: The UserInfo Claims MUST be returned as the members of a JSON object unless a signed or encrypted response was requested during Client Registration.
requirements.reason: Signed UserInfo responses are not offered: userinfo_signing_alg_values_supported is intentionally absent from discovery, so no client can request one and the plain JSON branch is the only reachable one.

requirements.quote: The OpenID Provider SHOULD support the certification process defined by the OpenID Foundation.
